QuestInfo.name: Nothing Remains
QuestInfo.0: None of the foxes recognize you. But you didn't see Moonbeam. Where is she? Did something happen to her? Ask Chief Silver.
QuestInfo.1: Silver said that Moonbeam cannot call on the spirits anymore. She sits by the Fox Tree doing nothing. The other foxes think she's been possessed by a ghost. Is there a chance she remembers you? Go find Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.2: You met Moonbeam. She's depressed that she cannot call on the spirits, and can't remember why. She doesn't remember you, either. Worst of all, your mark on the Fox Tree is gone.

0.msg: #bMoonbeam?#k You monster, how do you know about my granddaughter? Did she lead you here? What could she be thinking...? Ever since she lost her connection to the spirits, she's been a mess. She just sits by the Fox Tree, staring off into space. The others think she's possessed by a ghost.

1.msg: (By the Fox Tree? Maybe Moonbeam does remember! I have to find her!)

0.msg: (The #rFox Tree#k, right? The last place we were together... If it's still raining...!)
(None of them remember me. Not one. But... I didn't see Moonbeam. Could she...?)

2.msg: Shade? ...What a weird name. Where are your ears? And your tail? Are you sick or something?

4.msg: How...did you get here? Only foxes are allowed up here. Are you an outsider?

5.msg: I came... to see my friend.

6.msg: Your friend? Your friend lives around here? Is he a fox from our town? Oh, I bet you mean Tumbleweed.

7.msg: I left a mark of our friendship on this tree, but... Even that's gone. Everything's gone.

npc.0: How in the world did Moonbeam lose her spirits...
